scope: Static Stitch design exports only, not application behavior

findings.message: 4 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Site name", "Address", "Last updated", "Actions").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.
Darken or lighten the text colour.
Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.

findings.message: 33% of the first screen is one empty block (1440×300px at 0,480).
findings.fix: Place the void on purpose or fill it: move the picture, the film or one fact into it, grow the headline to meet it, or shrink the screen to its content. A void reads as placed only when something closes it on the far side and it is the screen's one rest.

findings.message: 1 card(s) hold a blank band inside: 369px in "Supply sites".
findings.fix: A card stretches to its neighbour only when it has content to fill. Keep a legend or a note directly under its chart (only an action or a total may sit at a stretched card's foot), let a short card keep its own height (align-items: start), and let a filtered block shrink to its rows.

findings.message: 1 text block(s) sit within 12px of the screen edge: "Next >" (9px from the right)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–20px). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: The sidebar still takes 42% of the width on a 390px phone.
findings.fix: On a phone the navigation folds into a top bar with a menu button or a bottom bar of four or five destinations; the screen's content gets the full width.

findings.message: 1 tiny uppercase letter-spaced label(s): "Design preview · Sample records"
findings.fix: Prefer sentence case at body size.
Darken or lighten the text colour.

findings.message: The screen has a chart but no hue on any of its data (0.0% coloured pixels).
findings.fix: Put the style's one chart hue (or the brand's) on the screen's main data element: today's line, the booked bars, the current period, the cover margin. Keep the chrome neutral; the hue still stays under the style's colour budget.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Add supply site" → 3 lines (3 words, 24px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: 1 text block(s) sit within 12px of the screen edge: "Canonical address" (8px from the right)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–20px). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.
